summary: Business Rules page testing complete. All reported issues have been fixed: 1) Policy card click to expand works correctly, 2) Add New Rule button appears for HR users, 3) Add New Rule dialog has all fields including Unit, 4) Edit rule form shows Unit field, 5) Save button works (tested creating LE013 rule), 6) SOP modal shows 200+ word detailed documentation with Payroll & Disbursement Linkage section.
seed_data_creation: Created test rule LE013 during UI testing, cleaned up after test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Business Rules page fully functional. All CRUD operations work. SOP modal displays comprehensive 200+ word documentation with all sections.

policy_card_click_expand.details: Clicking on policy cards (e.g., Standard Leave Policy) expands them to show rules and Add New Rule button

add_new_rule_button.details: Add New Rule button appears for HR users when policy is expanded, with data-testid='add-rule-leave'

add_new_rule_dialog.details: Dialog opens with all fields: Rule ID, Rule Type (dropdown), Rule Name, Description, Numeric Value, Unit, String Value, Category, Rule Enabled toggle

edit_rule_form.details: Edit dialog shows all fields including Unit field (e.g., 'days/year' for Casual Leave Quota)

save_button_works.details: Successfully created test rule LE013 with name 'TEST_Automated_Rule', numeric_value=99, unit='test_units'. Toast showed 'Rule LE013 added successfully'

sop_modal_200_words.details: SOP modal shows '200+ words' indicator in title. Detailed SOP Documentation section contains comprehensive documentation covering Overview, Rule Categories, Configuration Process, Payroll Integration Points, Best Practices

sop_payroll_linkage.details: Payroll & Disbursement Linkage section shows: Affects (LOP Deduction PY008, Leave Encashment LV011, F&F Calculation), Disbursement (Monthly Payroll & Exit Settlement), CTC Components (Basic Salary for per-day calculation)

sop_impact_analysis.details: Impact Analysis section shows Leave Balances (Direct), Payroll (Direct), F&F Settlement (Direct) with descriptions

sop_checklists.details: SOP modal contains expandable checklists: Critical Rules (4 items), Before Making Changes (5 items), Configuration Steps (6 items), Testing & Verification (5 items), Post-Change Actions (5 items)

sop_warnings.details: Warnings & Cautions section shows warning messages about reducing leave quota, disabling encashment, sandwich policy changes

delete_rule_api.details: DELETE /{policy_id}/rule/{rule_id} endpoint works correctly. Tested via API and cleaned up test rule LE013
